test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify and correct the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.**

Many people were enduering mental agony and health issues with the change in lifestyle.
solution: The correct answer is** "enduring**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** ** __ • In the given sentence, the incorrectly spelt word is **"enduering."** • The correct spelling of the word is **"enduring."** • The word **"enduring"** means lasting over a period of time; durable. (स्‍थायी, टिकाऊ) • **Example**:* I shall be left with many **enduring**__ memories of the time I spent in India.* • So, the correct answer is Option 1. ​ Correct sentence: *Many people were __**enduring**__ mental agony and health issues with the change in lifestyle. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Agouny: **The correct spelling is** "Agony." **It means** **great pain or suffering. (तीव्र वेदना, तेज़ पीड़ा, व्‍यथा, कष्‍ट) • **Heaolth: **The correct spelling is "Health." It means the condition of a person’s body or mind. (व्‍यक्ति के शरीर या मन की दशा; स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य, सेहत) • **Mentel: **The correct spelling is "Mental." It means connected with or happening in the mind; involving the process of thinking. (मन से संबंधित या मन में होने वाला, मानसिक; जिसमें सोचने की प्रक्रिया चले, दिमाग़ी) 20d:T1205, The correct answer is ****"The sage said that life is nothing but a journey of compromises."**
